events.title: fix(core): enforce maxTotalTimeout as a hard cap
events.excerpt: Fixes #2695. `maxTotalTimeout` is documented as a hard cap, but `_setupTimeout` armed the pending timer with `timeout` only. The cap was read in `_resetTimeout`, which runs only when a `notifications/progress` arrives with `resetTimeoutOnProgress` set. A request that never sends progress therefore outlived its own deadline, and a progress reset re-armed the full `timeout` instead of what was left of the total budget.
